questions.stem: Hydrated copper sulfate is blue; anhydrous copper sulfate is white. Which symbol should be used in the equation to show this is a reversible reaction?
questions.explanation: The double-headed equilibrium arrow (⇌) is used to show that a reaction is reversible. Heating blue hydrated copper sulfate drives off water to form white anhydrous copper sulfate, but adding water to the white powder reverses the change back to the blue form.
